local_registration: PDF circle center translated only to official102 stair center; no whole-plan warp
assumptions: The PDF stair icon has 12 divisions; they are not the real riser count.
540 degrees, 34 risers and the start/end angle are candidates. No measured end-point camera solution exists.
041/042 show a solid cylindrical central support, stepped underside, exterior glass guard and an inner metal rail.
043/044 show a round inner rail, round wall plate, short standoff and a top termination bending around the column. Their dimensions are not measured.
The upper landing corridor follows the official103 white circulation region; joining the earlier independent gallery floor requires local source comparison.
Column finish is represented as stone family; actual hidden structure and build-up are unknown.
Official103 diagonal room edge was sampled at x=324..350; dark pixels follow y=x+10..11. PDF upper icon attaches at a different angle, so angular end/top landing remains explicitly conditional.
A quarter-turn upper landing with a radial exit into the source white circulation triangle is a candidate; full-circle void below must remain open for spiral headroom.
Angular magnitude and exact start/end remain conditional, but v002 reverses the initial candidate to agree with the southwest upper landing and photo041 lower entry.
